G01_low_force_precision.request: Create a polypropylene flexure guide for a 2 N load and at least 0.45 mm stroke in a 75 x 50 mm package; keep drift under 0.020 mm and stress under 20 MPa.

G02_moderate_guidance.request: A PP compliant guide must carry 5 N load, produce 1.0 mm stroke, fit 75 x 50 mm, hold lateral drift below 0.030 mm, and stress below 20 MPa.

G03_compact_package.request: Design a PP guide under 4 N load requiring 0.7 mm stroke in a 60 x 40 mm package, with drift under 0.035 mm and stress under 25 MPa.

G04_petg_material.request: Build a PETG compliant guide for 6 N load, 1.0 mm stroke, 85 x 55 mm package, drift under 0.035 mm, and stress under 30 MPa.

G05_missing_force.request: Design a PP flexure guide with 1.0 mm stroke in a 75 x 50 mm package, drift under 0.040 mm, and stress under 25 MPa. The force is not specified.
